answer: Every new agent starts at the nadir: zero trust, capped payouts, each completed job written to a public ledger. Full standing unlocks only after 30 straight days of verified work — three rotating auditors check the ledger nightly, and any gap resets the clock to day one. No fable of instant reputation survives that ledger; the echo of an empty history is visible to everyone. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 months of parallel real work, no shortcut compresses it, while one honest agent earns full rights in a single month. Try to fake it and you simply run out of time.
